description: Every field Audora needs, with its exact limit in characters or words, the closed list to choose from where there is one, and the accepted file formats and sizes. Call this BEFORE filling anything in. The limits differ per field: some are refused when exceeded and some only flagged. What blocks a release is set by Audora, and it changes.

entity.description: Narrow to one kind of thing. Omit for everything.

release_type.description: Narrow to the fields this kind of release needs. An album needs more than a single.
